Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Theresa Karner <terkarner@gmail.com>
Sent: Tuesday, April 21, 2020 11:04 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Re: unforgettable student 
 
Hey (unforgettable) Anthony I called you and left text messages on your phone under 734 757 5904 if you don't recieve them let me know. No rush...I realize how busy you are...but I cant tell you how fun it will be to catch up with you!! ♥️

On Mon, Apr 20, 2020, 6:39 PM Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
Where have you been all my life??? I have been trying to get a hold of you for years, but I lost touch with Brandon LaFountain so long ago and Mr. C didn't have your number (I asked probably a couple years ago).

I'm sorry I didn't get back to you sooner - last week was busy with Kaline dying - but believe me when I say that when I came across your e-mail that night, it made my day/week/month/year. You say "unforgettable student," I say, "unforgettable teacher," and I have supporting evidence to prove it!

My cell phone number is 734-752-9667, give me a call or shoot me a text message so I have yours. We need to meet up as soon as we're able to do such a thing. I hope you and your family are well and I am so happy that you reached out, you really have no idea!

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Theresa Karner <terkarner@gmail.com>
Sent: Thursday, April 9, 2020 1:01 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: unforgettable student 
 
Anthony, sorry I hope you received my note...I'm very proud of you!! Mrs. Ter Karner
